details:
Q1. What specifically should be improved?
Choices:
A. A bug or incorrect behavior in an existing feature (RECOMMENDED)
B. A UX/UI improvement to an existing screen or workflow
C. Performance or reliability improvement
D. Something else — describe the exact problem in 1-2 sentences
Q2. Which part of the repository should the change target?
Choices:
A. GitHub Actions workflow behavior under `.github/workflows/` (RECOMMENDED)
B. Shell/Python helper scripts under `scripts/`
C. Documentation or templates
D. I’m not sure — use the files most directly related to the problem I describe in Q1
Q3. How should we judge that the change is complete?
Choices:
A. A specific broken scenario is fixed — describe the before/after behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific workflow/log/error message is improved — paste the exact text
C. A measurable outcome is improved — name the metric or limit
D. Match an example/expected output — provide the example
Q4. What level of change do you want?
Choices:
A. Small, minimal fix only (RECOMMENDED)
B. Moderate improvement within the directly affected area
C. Broader cleanup/refactor if needed to make it better
